payload.description:
## Trigger

When a consumer shapes a record for an agent to verify against, I want the gate to read one store rather than two, so I can stop the disagreement D-50 was written to end.

D-50 decided that acceptance_criteria and requirements are fields and not headings, that the field becomes the only reader, and that the heading survives only as a read-only fallback for a closed record and is refused for an open one. The shaping module shipped in basicly-b84ql8z accepts a heading on any record. Measured 2026-09-18: a heading-only open record owes nothing, so the gate passes it.

I built that fallback deliberately for backward compatibility and did not check it against the decision before doing so. D-50's own argument applies to the kit unchanged: two representations of one truth is a disagreement that already happened, and the reader that exists reads the weaker store. This repository's own 94 records carrying both stores and disagreeing are what that looks like.

The consequence is the migration D-50 already sized, not a surprise. 782 records carry the heading and 467 carry the field, so tightening the gate makes heading-only open records report what they owe. That is the correct reading of their state, and closed records keep the heading as evidence.
payload.title: make the kit gate read the field on an open record as D-50 already decided

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value: owed reads acceptance_criteria and requirements from the fields alone on an open record; a heading-only open record reports both as owed, and dor refuses it. A closed record still reads the heading as a fallback, so evidence already written stays readable. The trigger stays a heading, which D-50 keeps.

payload.name: requirements
payload.value: The kit takes closedness as an argument rather than importing the vocabulary, so shaping stays a leaf module. No engine import, standard library only, Python 3.9 floor. Every caller passes the record's real status, because defaulting to open would mark 1020 closed records as owing. The engine seam must be able to write both fields before the gate reads only them.

payload.acceptance_criteria: architecture.md carries D-51 stating the decision, what it costs and what it refuses, and the docs that describe getting a kit agree with it
payload.description:
## Trigger

When someone asks how a consumer gets basicly or one of its kits, I want the answer on the record rather than in a conversation, so I can stop a later session proposing a package index again.

The owner decided 2026-09-18: no PyPI. basicly and all three kits are distributed from the repository and installed with uvx. That removes a backlog item I had ranked and would otherwise have proposed again.
payload.requirements: the decision is recorded where the other fifty are, not in a changelog entry or a README aside; no committed command line carries a machine-specific path
payload.title: record the repo-as-distribution decision as D-51
